import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyOpenCover
import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomologyPair

/-!
# Singular cohomology Mayer--Vietoris

The restriction and overlap-difference maps are the ordinary singular
cohomology maps of subspace inclusions. Small-chain comparison identifies
these maps with the simplicial Mayer--Vietoris sequence. This is infrastructure
for the product calculation in Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1, integral cohomology.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X)

/-- Restriction of an ambient cohomology class to two subspaces. -/
def singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology X n ⟶
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of U) n ⊞
        IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of V) n :=
  biprod.lift
    (homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X U)) n)
    (homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X V)) n)

/-- Difference of the two restrictions to the intersection. -/
def singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of U) n ⊞
        IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of V) n ⟶
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n :=
  biprod.desc
    (homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
      (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_left)) n)
    (-homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
      (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_right)) n)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_difference (n : ℕ) :
    singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n ≫
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference X U V n = 0 := by
  have h : integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X U) ≫
        integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_left) =
      integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X V) ≫
        integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_right) := by
    change integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _) ≫
        integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _) =
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _) ≫
        integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)
    rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp,
      ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  simp [singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction, singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference,
    biprod.lift_desc, ← homologyMap_comp, h]

/-- The ordinary singular cohomology restriction/difference short complex. -/
def singularCohomologyMayerVietoris (n : ℕ) : ShortComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) :=
  ShortComplex.mk _ _ (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_difference X U V n)

/-- Identify the cohomology of the simplicial pair with the cohomology of
the two actual topological subspaces. -/
def singularPairCohomologyIso (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex (singularSubset X U)
      (singularSubset X V)).homology n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of U) n ⊞
        IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of V) n :=
  integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso n ≪≫
    biprod.mapIso (singularSubsetCohomologyIso X U n) (singularSubsetCohomologyIso X V n)

@[reassoc]
theorem singularPairCohomologyIso_restriction (n : ℕ) :
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
        (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι) n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction
        (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)) n ≫
      (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom =
        singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n := by
  change _ = biprod.lift
    (homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
      (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X U))) n)
    (homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
      (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X V))) n)
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · simp only [singularPairCohomologyIso, Iso.trans_hom, biprod.mapIso_hom,
      integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso, Category.assoc, biprod.map_fst,
      biprod.lift_fst_assoc]
    erw [biprod.lift_fst]
    rw [← Category.assoc (homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction
        (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)) n),
      integralSimplicialCohomologyUnionRestriction_fst,
      ← Category.assoc, ← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
    convert singularSubsetCohomologyIso_restriction X U n using 1 <;> rfl
  · simp only [singularPairCohomologyIso, Iso.trans_hom, biprod.mapIso_hom,
      integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso, Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd,
      biprod.lift_snd_assoc]
    erw [biprod.lift_snd]
    rw [← Category.assoc (homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction
        (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)) n),
      integralSimplicialCohomologyUnionRestriction_snd,
      ← Category.assoc, ← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
    convert singularSubsetCohomologyIso_restriction X V n using 1 <;> rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
